summary: Banco Santander filed a Form 6-K reporting weekly transactions under its ongoing share buyback programme. Between 28 May and 3 June 2026, it purchased 12,765,369 shares at a weighted average price of roughly €10.67-10.78, bringing total spend to €2.966 billion (59% of the maximum investment amount). The programme was announced 4 February 2026; repurchased shares represent ~17% of 2021 outstanding shares. This is a structural capital return event (share buyback) disclosed via foreign issuer 6-K, mapping to a US issuer’s 8-K for repurchase activity. Watch for ongoing buyback progress and potential completion timeline.
